name: cookieflare
description: CookieCloud-compatible API on Cloudflare Workers and KV

scripts.check: npm run build:console && tsc --noEmit && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && npm run doctor && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.verify: npm run types && npm run check && npm test
scripts.preview: npm run build:console && wrangler dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8798 --inspector-port 9238 --persist-to .wrangler/nuxt-preview --var ADMIN_USERNAME:admin --var ADMIN_PASSWORD:password --var COOKIECLOUD_UPDATE_TOKEN:
